messages.content: How do I check if a Python string is a palindrome?

<action>
<reasoning>The user wants a concise Python solution to check if a string is a palindrome. I can provide a one-liner using slicing.</reasoning>
<tool>agent.finish</tool>
<content>Use slicing to compare the string with its reverse: `is_pal = s == s[::-1]`. For case-insensitive and alphanumeric-only checks, sanitize first with `clean = ''.join(c.lower() for c in s if c.isalnum())` then compare `clean == clean[::-1]`.</content>
</action>
